title: Mimi, Clover, and Willow's Flower Gift
markdown:
Once upon a time, in a meadow soft and green, lived a little kitten named Mimi. Her very best friend was Clover, a gentle calf with kind, big eyes. Every day, they played in their sunny meadow, Mimi chasing butterflies and Clover munching sweet clover leaves. It was peaceful and warm, like a lovely lullaby.

Until one day, a little foal named Willow came to the meadow. Willow stood all by herself, a little quiet. Mimi and Clover remembered feeling new, and they wanted Willow to feel welcome.

So, they decided to make a surprise. Mimi and Clover gathered pretty daisies, making a beautiful daisy chain. Then, they walked gently to Willow. Mimi let out a soft mew, and Clover gave a friendly moo. They held out the flowers, seeming to whisper, "Hello! We are happy you are here!"

Willow looked at the daisy chain, then at Mimi and Clover. A shy smile bloomed on her face. She gently took the daisy chain, letting it rest on her head like a crown of sunshine. A warm, gentle friendship grew between them, as soft as a well-loved blanket.

Ever since that day, Mimi, Clover, and Willow were the very best of meadow friends. They played under the warm sun, their laughter a gentle melody on the peaceful air. As silvery moonbeams gleamed through the tall grass, and the little stars twinkled their sleepy goodnights, the three friends would curl up together, feeling so safe and wonderfully happy, ready for the sweetest dreams to fill their slumber.
characters: Mimi the kitten, Clover the calf
